query_plans.sql:
WITH matched AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM dl_evidence.observation WHERE derivation_id=%s AND entity_type='provider_entities'
 AND fields->'npi' ? %s AND source_row_ordinal>%s ORDER BY source_row_ordinal LIMIT 21)
 SELECT o.*,r.raw_payload,r.raw_sha256,r.record_id,r.source_row_key,r.ordinal_basis,
 d.snapshot_id,d.adapter_code_sha256,s.original_path,s.artifact_sha256,
 s.source_use_state AS snapshot_source_use_state FROM matched o
 JOIN dl_evidence.source_record r USING(derivation_id,source_table,source_row_ordinal)
 JOIN dl_control.derivation d USING(derivation_id)
 JOIN dl_control.source_snapshot s USING(snapshot_id) ORDER BY o.source_row_ordinal

WITH matched AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM dl_evidence.observation WHERE derivation_id=%s AND entity_type='provider_roles'
 AND (fields->>'provider_key'=ANY(%s) OR fields->>'entity_key'=ANY(%s)) AND source_row_ordinal>%s ORDER BY source_row_ordinal LIMIT 51)
 SELECT o.*,r.raw_payload,r.raw_sha256,r.record_id,r.source_row_key,r.ordinal_basis,
 d.snapshot_id,d.adapter_code_sha256,s.original_path,s.artifact_sha256,
 s.source_use_state AS snapshot_source_use_state FROM matched o
 JOIN dl_evidence.source_record r USING(derivation_id,source_table,source_row_ordinal)
 JOIN dl_control.derivation d USING(derivation_id)
 JOIN dl_control.source_snapshot s USING(snapshot_id) ORDER BY o.source_row_ordinal

remaining_limits: Composite normalized directory snapshot, not a complete provider roster or current registry verification.
NPI-bearing practitioners, organizations, roles and locations remain distinct source entities.
Only explicit role provider/location references form site candidates; organization membership is not a substitute.
Names or matching addresses do not merge entities/sites; shared sites and multiple roles remain separate.
A source active flag or period does not establish current practice, participation, network access or appointments.
Missing, truncated or conflicting source references are unresolved, never a negative coverage finding.
Federal hospital IDs, Original Medicare assignments/enrollment/optout, and medical-plan network findings need separate methods and sources.
Every site candidate still requires explicit item/person/time disambiguation; customer confirmation grants no consumer source authority.
The composite wellcare-r5 database includes multiple directory publishers; it is not a Wellcare-only roster.
This receipt checks five exact selectors and their raw parents, not the semantic correctness or currentness of all retained provider records.
Exact selectors use existing derivation/lineage indexes and filter a bounded source slice; no dedicated NPI/entity JSON index, migration or schema change was added.
Lookup wall times are seconds for richer source cases; no interactive latency or concurrency acceptance is claimed.
Synthetic tests cover null actors, pagination/truncation, response caps, STOP/stale source state and malformed/lineage drift without altering real source records.
Native observation locators preserve exact raw-parent hashes/pointers; their large raw FHIR payloads are not duplicated in this receipt.

request_selection.basis: Retained public source-only exact role/location keys; no customer/profile input.

source_selection_sql.location_only: SELECT e.entity_key FROM entities e JOIN locations l ON l.entity_key=e.entity_key WHERE e.type='Location' ORDER BY e.entity_key LIMIT 1
source_selection_sql.role_without_separately_retained_actor: SELECT e.entity_key FROM entities e JOIN roles r ON r.entity_key=e.entity_key LEFT JOIN entities a ON a.entity_key=r.provider_key WHERE e.type='PractitionerRole' AND a.entity_key IS NULL ORDER BY e.entity_key LIMIT 1
